source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, Task, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Concept prototype — validate the core idea is worth designing before writing GDDs. Run right after /brainstorm and /setup-engine. Routes to HTML, Engine, or Paper path based on game type. Produces a throwaway build and a PROCEED/PIVOT/KILL verdict.
source_metadata.name: prototype

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Generate a QA test plan for a sprint or feature. Reads GDDs and story files, classifies stories by test type (Logic/Integration/Visual/UI), and produces a structured test plan covering automated tests required, manual test cases, smoke test scope, and playtest sign-off requirements. Run before sprint begins or when starting a major feature.
source_metadata.name: qa-plan

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Lightweight design spec for small changes — tuning adjustments, minor mechanics, balance tweaks. Skips full GDD authoring when a system GDD already exists or the change is too small to warrant one. Produces a Quick Design Spec that embeds directly into story files.
source_metadata.name: quick-design

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Map test coverage to GDD critical paths, identify fixed bugs without regression tests, flag coverage drift from new features, and maintain tests/regression-suite.md. Run after implementing a bug fix or before a release gate.
source_metadata.name: regression-suite

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write
source_metadata.description: Generates a comprehensive pre-release validation checklist covering build verification, certification requirements, store metadata, and launch readiness.
source_metadata.name: release-checklist

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Bash, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Generates a sprint or milestone retrospective by analyzing completed work, velocity, blockers, and patterns. Produces actionable insights for the next iteration.
source_metadata.name: retrospective

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash
source_metadata.description: Generate design or architecture documents from existing implementation. Works backwards from code/prototypes to create missing planning docs.
source_metadata.name: reverse-document

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Bash, AskUserQuestion, Task
source_metadata.description: Holistic cross-GDD consistency and game design review. Reads all system GDDs simultaneously and checks for contradictions between them, stale references, ownership conflicts, formula incompatibilities, and game design theory violations (dominant strategies, economic imbalance, cognitive overload, pillar drift). Run after all MVP GDDs are written, before architecture begins.
source_metadata.name: review-all-gdds

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash
source_metadata.description: Analyze a feature or sprint for scope creep by comparing current scope against the original plan. Flags additions, quantifies bloat, and recommends cuts. Use when user says 'any scope creep', 'scope review', 'are we staying in scope'.
source_metadata.name: scope-check

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Task
source_metadata.description: Audit the game for security vulnerabilities: save tampering, cheat vectors, network exploits, data exposure, and input validation gaps. Produces a prioritised security report with remediation guidance. Run before any public release or multiplayer launch.
source_metadata.name: security-audit

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, WebSearch, WebFetch, Task, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.argument-hint: [engine] | [engine version] | refresh | upgrade [old-version] [new-version] | no args for guided selection
source_metadata.description: Configure the project's game engine and version. Pins the engine in CLAUDE.md, detects knowledge gaps, and populates engine reference docs via WebSearch when the version is beyond the LLM's training data.
source_metadata.name: setup-engine

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Bash
source_metadata.description: Improve a skill using a test-fix-retest loop. Runs static checks, proposes targeted fixes, rewrites the skill, re-tests, and keeps or reverts based on score change.
source_metadata.name: skill-improve

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write
source_metadata.argument-hint: static [skill-name | all] | spec [skill-name] | category [skill-name | all] | audit
source_metadata.description: Validate skill files for structural compliance and behavioral correctness. Three modes: static (linter), spec (behavioral), audit (coverage report).
source_metadata.name: skill-test

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Run the critical path smoke test gate before QA hand-off. Executes the automated test suite, verifies core functionality, and produces a PASS/FAIL report. Run after a sprint's stories are implemented and before manual QA begins. A failed smoke check means the build is not ready for QA.
source_metadata.name: smoke-check

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write
source_metadata.description: Generate a soak test protocol for extended play sessions. Defines what to observe, measure, and log during long play sessions to surface slow leaks, fatigue effects, and edge cases that only appear after sustained play. Primarily used in Polish and Release phases.
source_metadata.name: soak-test

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Task, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Generates a new sprint plan or updates an existing one based on the current milestone, completed work, and available capacity. Pulls context from production documents and design backlogs.
source_metadata.name: sprint-plan

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep
source_metadata.description: Fast sprint status check. Reads the current sprint plan, scans story files for status, and produces a concise progress snapshot with burndown assessment and emerging risks. Run at any time during a sprint for quick situational awareness. Use when user asks 'how is the sprint going', 'sprint update', 'show sprint progress'.
source_metadata.name: sprint-status

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: First-time onboarding — asks where you are, then guides you to the right workflow. No assumptions.
source_metadata.name: start

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, AskUserQuestion, Task
source_metadata.description: End-of-story completion review. Reads the story file, verifies each acceptance criterion against the implementation, checks for GDD/ADR deviations, prompts code review, updates story status to Complete, and surfaces the next ready story from the sprint.
source_metadata.name: story-done

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, AskUserQuestion, Task
source_metadata.description: Validate that a story file is implementation-ready. Checks for embedded GDD requirements, ADR references, engine notes, clear acceptance criteria, and no open design questions. Produces READY / NEEDS WORK / BLOCKED verdict with specific gaps. Use when user says 'is this story ready', 'can I start on this story', 'is story X ready to implement'.
source_metadata.name: story-readiness

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, Task, AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite
source_metadata.argument-hint: [feature or area to design audio for] [--review full|lean|solo]
source_metadata.description: Orchestrate audio team: audio-director + sound-designer + technical-artist + gameplay-programmer for full audio pipeline from direction to implementation.
source_metadata.name: team-audio

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, Task, AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite
source_metadata.description: Orchestrate the combat team: coordinates game-designer, gameplay-programmer, ai-programmer, technical-artist, sound-designer, and qa-tester to design, implement, and validate a combat feature end-to-end.
source_metadata.name: team-combat

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, Task, AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite
source_metadata.argument-hint: [level name or area to design] [--review full|lean|solo]
source_metadata.description: Orchestrate level design team: level-designer + narrative-director + world-builder + art-director + systems-designer + qa-tester for complete area/level creation.
source_metadata.name: team-level

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, Task, AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite
source_metadata.description: Orchestrate the live-ops team for post-launch content planning: coordinates live-ops-designer, economy-designer, analytics-engineer, community-manager, writer, and narrative-director to design and plan a season, event, or live content update.
source_metadata.name: team-live-ops

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Task, AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite
source_metadata.description: Orchestrate the narrative team: coordinates narrative-director, writer, world-builder, and level-designer to create cohesive story content, world lore, and narrative-driven level design.
source_metadata.name: team-narrative

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, Task, AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite
source_metadata.description: Orchestrate the polish team: coordinates performance-analyst, technical-artist, sound-designer, and qa-tester to optimize, polish, and harden a feature or area for release quality.
source_metadata.name: team-polish

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Task, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Orchestrate the QA team through a full testing cycle. Coordinates qa-lead (strategy + test plan) and qa-tester (test case writing + bug reporting) to produce a complete QA package for a sprint or feature. Covers: test plan generation, test case writing, smoke check gate, manual QA execution, and sign-off report.
source_metadata.name: team-qa

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, Task, AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite
source_metadata.description: Orchestrate the release team: coordinates release-manager, qa-lead, devops-engineer, and producer to execute a release from candidate to deployment.
source_metadata.name: team-release

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, Task, AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite
source_metadata.description: Orchestrate the UI team through the full UX pipeline: from UX spec authoring through visual design, implementation, review, and polish. Integrates with /ux-design, /ux-review, and studio UX templates.
source_metadata.name: team-ui

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Track, categorize, and prioritize technical debt across the codebase. Scans for debt indicators, maintains a debt register, and recommends repayment scheduling.
source_metadata.name: tech-debt

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write
source_metadata.description: Quality review of test files and manual evidence documents. Goes beyond existence checks — evaluates assertion coverage, edge case handling, naming conventions, and evidence completeness. Produces ADEQUATE/INCOMPLETE/MISSING verdict per story. Run before QA sign-off or on demand.
source_metadata.name: test-evidence-review

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash
source_metadata.description: Detect non-deterministic (flaky) tests by reading CI run logs or test result history. Aggregates pass rates per test, identifies intermittent failures, recommends quarantine or fix, and maintains a flaky test registry. Best run during Polish phase or after multiple CI runs.
source_metadata.name: test-flakiness

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write
source_metadata.description: Generate engine-specific test helper libraries for the project's test suite. Reads existing test patterns and produces tests/helpers/ with assertion utilities, factory functions, and mock objects tailored to the project's systems. Reduces boilerplate in new test files.
source_metadata.name: test-helpers

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write
source_metadata.description: Scaffold the test framework and CI/CD pipeline for the project's engine. Creates the tests/ directory structure, engine-specific test runner configuration, and GitHub Actions workflow. Run once during Technical Setup phase before the first sprint begins.
source_metadata.name: test-setup

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, AskUserQuestion, Task
source_metadata.description: Guided, section-by-section UX spec authoring for a screen, flow, or HUD. Reads game concept, player journey, and relevant GDDs to provide context-aware design guidance. Produces ux-spec.md (per screen/flow) or hud-design.md using the studio templates.
source_metadata.name: ux-design

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep
source_metadata.description: Validates a UX spec, HUD design, or interaction pattern library for completeness, accessibility compliance, GDD alignment, and implementation readiness. Produces APPROVED / NEEDS REVISION / MAJOR REVISION NEEDED verdict with specific gaps.
source_metadata.name: ux-review

source_metadata.allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash, Task, AskUserQuestion
source_metadata.description: Pre-Production validation — build a production-quality end-to-end build to confirm the full game loop is achievable before committing to Production. Run after GDDs, architecture, and UX specs are complete. Produces a PROCEED/PIVOT/KILL verdict that gates the Pre-Production → Production transition.
source_metadata.name: vertical-slice
